name: teleport
description: Share individual app windows from a headless Mac to the Mac you work on, Coherence-style.

scripts.stop: pkill -x Teleport; pkill -x TeleportDockTile; pkill -f 'livekit-server --config' || true
scripts.deps: brew list livekit >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install livekit
scripts.start:loopback-host: npm run bundle && open -n --env TELEPORT_HOME=$HOME/.teleport-host build/Teleport.app
